description: This line plot illustrates the loss ratio (%) as a function of TFLOPs for four variants of the SepLLM model. The x-axis represents TFLOPs on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels spaced at intervals of one order of magnitude. The y-axis represents the Loss Ratio (%) on a linear scale, ranging from 94% to 100%. The plot contains four lines: the purple line with triangle markers (SepLLM (n=64)) starts at approximately 100% and remains constant; the orange line (SepLLM (n=64)) begins at approximately 98.2% and rises to a peak of 100% near 4e8 TFLOPs before declining slightly; the blue line with cross markers (SepLLM (n=128)) begins at approximately 97% and increases steadily to nearly 100% by 9e8 TFLOPs; the green line with diamond markers (SepLLM (n=64, H)) starts at approximately 97.5% and rises to nearly 100% by 6e8 TFLOPs; and the red line with circular markers (SepLLM (n=64, H/T)) begins at 94% and rises steeply to approximately 99% before leveling off near 99% by 9e8 TFLOPs.
